summary: On July 9, 2026 the Jennings County (Indiana) Clerk's Office identified that an attacker had gained unauthorized access to the Clerk's Microsoft 365 email account and used it, just before 11:30 a.m., to send a phishing email with a malicious link to county employees and numerous external recipients. The county recalled internal copies, secured the account and warned recipients not to click the link.
